scope: 100000 classified unit rectangles, one immutable dense source and local SQLite recovery file. Owner capture copies canonical maps/text and shares immutable geometry/pixels; budget estimates retained payload and no history/index is cloned. One background job includes durable SQLite commits, integrity check, atomic publication and snapshot release. Primary remains unchanged/dirty state retained. Cold/network storage, vendor readers, power-loss and long-running pressure are excluded. GUI: 100000 selected, narrow view; frame metrics include capture and concurrent IO after ten warm-up frames, excluding swap wait.
